Throughout his life, Julian has worked to establish himself beyond the shadow of his father's towering legacy, pursuing his own artistic endeavors and interests that extend well beyond music into philanthropy and environmental causes.

The conversation between Rogan and Lennon covered general topics, allowing for the kind of wide-ranging discussion that has become a hallmark of the Joe Rogan Experience format. He has been known for his environmental advocacy and various charitable endeavors, reflecting a commitment to causes beyond entertainment. His position as the child of a cultural icon has given him both advantages and challenges throughout his life, and discussions of his experiences often provide interesting perspectives on fame, family legacy, and personal growth.
